correctness.rationale: For a finite abelian H, lambda(H) is minimum length of a sequence, repetitions allowed, with all 0/1 subsums equal H; 2^k>=|H| gives the entropy bound. Binary powers in each invariant cyclic factor give sum ceil(log2 d_j) entries. An exact partition-based enumeration of the 38 abelian isomorphism types of orders 2..25 shows this matches ceil(log2|H|) except C5xC5 at 25. For C5^2 every spanning five-term sequence can choose a basis among its terms and normalize it to e1,e2: all 25^3 remaining triples (with repetitions) are exhausted by the recurrence S <- S union (S+v); maximum size 24, attained by 480 ordered normalized triples. Independent full 53130 five-subset census found exactly 1920 extremizers, partitioned by all 480 GL2 matrices into 6 orbits of sizes 120,120,240,480,480,480. Six explicit vectors with duplicate coordinate entries cover all 25 points; thus lambda(C5^2)=6. An independent checker rebuilt the normalized exhaustive search, subset census and linear orbits, agreeing exactly.
residual_risks: The maximum24, full orbit count and first exception are exact computer-assisted enumerations; all finite cases have been exhaustively covered by shown normalization, not extrapolated from a small sample.
The claim does not cover group orders greater than 25 or affine rather than linear classification.
